label: Bible Study
prompt: Create in me a _____ heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
verse: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
note: David's prayer after his sin with Bathsheba — he asks for a new heart, not a fresh coat of paint.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose _____ thou art come to trust.
verse: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to trust.
note: Boaz blesses the Moabite widow with refuge under God's wings — then becomes part of the answer himself.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and _____ of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
verse: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
note: Esau traded his birthright for 'pottage of lentiles' — history's most expensive bowl of lentil stew.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that _____ the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
verse: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
note: Little foxes raided vineyards in bloom — small troubles can wreck a budding love.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, _____, and abundant in goodness and truth,
verse: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
note: God's own self-description to Moses on Sinai — 'longsuffering,' the KJV's one word for slow to anger.
